$comment: Gate 24 measurements (tests/browser/first-paint-gate.browser.mjs) that fail for a reason outside the first paint, each with that reason. Reported by every run, not counted; an entry that passes again is reported under knownNowPassing and is taken out.

known.copy-button/reference: As copy-button/link: the icon subset's arrival moves the line by 1 px.
known.copy-button/target: As copy-button/link: the icon subset's arrival moves the line by 1 px.
known.copy-button/text: As copy-button/link: the icon subset's arrival moves the line by 1 px.
known.page-header/path-and-action: The page gives the header a <sf-button> with its label as text («Создать»); text cannot be held out of view beside a picture, so the action button shows its text for the frames until its own code draws it (shift 0.0006). A server prints the label as the button's text setting.
